correctness.rationale: For every a,b>0, H is C1, proper, strictly increasing radially, and every E>0 level is a regular simple periodic oval. Direct branch inversion gives exact period and area quadratures. Complete elliptic integral asymptotics give the upper logarithm and constants. On the lower branch y=u(E)z, domination by (1-z²)^(-1/2) proves beta constants and conditional laws. Upper truncated logarithmic quadratures prove uniform log-coordinate sampling. Beta recurrence B(1/4,3/2)=2B(1/4,1/2)/3 yields universal 2/3 time/area relative bias. A standalone executable check reproduces derivative identities and numerical limits, not relied on as infinite proof.
